name: Protect GraphQL API
description: Protect GraphQL endpoint from typical attacks

params.name: BLOCK_DEBUG
params.descr: Block debug parameter in query or variables, true/false (false by default)

params.name: BLOCKED_FIELDS
params.descr: Query fields to block, i.e. to disable introspection, comma-separated list

params.name: ENDPOINT
params.descr: Endpoint path, with leading slash, "/graphql" by default

params.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
params.descr: Max number of queries in batch requests, not checked by default

params.name: MAX_BODY_SIZE
params.descr: Max size of request body, in bytes, not checked by default

params.name: MAX_QUERY_DEPTH
params.descr: Max depth of nested queries, not checked by default

params.name: MAX_VALUE_SIZE
params.descr: Max size of single value in request, in bytes, not checked by default
